notes: Microsoft Sweden Central Azure region data centers at Ersbo, Stackbo (Valbo) and Tuna in Gavle municipality; land bought 2018-2019 from Gavle and Sandviken municipalities (66 ha Ersbo, 200 ha Stackbo); region operational since late 2021.
